Any.description: Placeholder range for slots whose value type is enumerated in any_of.
Any.title: Any

DepositConnector.description: An override only: how the harness deposits a draft to the repository through its API (docs/specs/deposit.md, Depositing through an API). It holds no credential: each researcher deposits with their own, held outside the app and the harness.

transport.description: The transport that moves the deposit, registered under the entry-point group dd.transports, such as zenodo.

format.description: The format the transport carries, from the pairs docs/specs/deposit.md allows, such as zenodo-deposit.

base_url.description: The installation's API root, such as https://sandbox.zenodo.org/api.

target.description: Where the draft is created, in the transport's own terms, such as a Zenodo community. Absent where the transport has a default.

sandbox.description: Whether base_url is the platform's test installation, whose items and identifiers are not real. The app says so beside the deposit.

DepositConnector.title: DepositConnector

DocumentKind.description: What a project document is for (docs/specs/projects.md).
DocumentKind.title: DocumentKind

Obligation.description: Whether a requirement set's field or document stops a package (docs/specs/deposit.md).
Obligation.title: Obligation

RequirementField.description: One metadata property a requirement set requires or recommends.

property.description: The schema's property, such as DataCite's titles or types.resourceTypeGeneral.

qualifier.description: Values that narrow the property, such as a subjectScheme. Part of what identifies a field when an override is merged with its standard's set.

term.description: The term of an existing vocabulary the property maps to, by which the record is read as RDF: a CURIE with a registered prefix (schema, dcterms, dcat or prov), such as dcterms:provenance, or the full IRI of a term in one of those vocabularies (docs/specs/metadata-standards.md, invariant 7). A set kept before terms were IRIs names a schema.org local name in schema_org, which reads as schema:<name>.

form_label.description: An override only: the label of the repository's deposit form field the value goes in.

supplied_on.description: Where in the app a researcher supplies the field's value, which validation names beside a missing one. Absent means documents, the metadata record's questions.

RequirementField.title: RequirementField

SuppliedOn.description: The page of a project where a researcher supplies a value a deposit needs (docs/specs/deposit.md, Validation).
SuppliedOn.title: SuppliedOn

description: What a deposit must or should have (docs/specs/deposit.md). A standard's set covers any record in one metadata standard and names it in re3data_names; a repository override adds what one repository asks and names it in re3data_id. The harness merges the two for the repository a researcher chose, checks the project against the result, and gives it to the drafters. Kept as YAML in the deployment's configuration, not sent by agents.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

requirement_set_id.description: Identifies the requirement set, such as datacite-4 or orda.

version.description: The version of the set, raised on every change.

title.description: What a person calls the standard or the repository.

url.description: Where the standard or the repository is described.

conforms_to.description: The URI of the metadata schema. An override names the standard's set it builds on.

re3data_names.description: A standard's set only: the metadataStandardName values in re3data that select it.

re3data_id.description: An override only: the repository's re3data identifier, such as r3d100012124.

repository_id.description: A repository's identifier in the registry that lists it: its re3data identifier, such as r3d100012124, where re3data lists it, else its DataCite repository identifier, such as bl.york. An override names it in place of re3data_id for a repository re3data does not list.

fields.description: The metadata properties the set requires or recommends.

required_documents.description: The document kinds that must have an approved version before a package is built.

recommended_documents.description: The document kinds whose absence is a warning.

filled_by_repository.description: The properties the schema makes mandatory that the repository fills in itself when it registers the record, such as DataCite's publisher and publicationYear, so the researcher is not asked for them. Validation says so as information, never as a violation; in a merged set, the standard's first, then the override's.

media_types.description: An override only: the media types the repository accepts. Empty means any.

max_file_size.description: An override only: the largest file the repository accepts, in bytes.

max_item_size.description: An override only: the largest deposit the repository accepts, in bytes.

licences.description: An override only: the licences the repository offers, each an SPDX identifier or the URL of the repository's own terms.

guidance.description: The pages the set's values were taken from, so that a steward can check them; in a merged set, the standard's first, then the override's.

unconfirmed.description: What the set's sources leave open, each a short statement naming the issue that will settle it, such as "Whether ORDA's form makes any other field mandatory (#385)". Shown to the person depositing; in a merged set, the standard's first, then the override's.

deposit.description: An override only: the API the harness may deposit a draft through. Without it the repository is deposited to by hand.

title: RequirementSet
